# IndraMQTT settings reference

<!-- GENERATED by `bash tools/gen_config_schema.sh`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every setting has exactly one typed home in the configuration schema. Wrong types and out-of-range values are startup errors naming the setting.

## node

| Setting | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `node.id` | string | `indra-node-1` | string | Unique identifier for this broker node within the cluster. |
| `node.data_dir` | string | `./data` | string | Directory holding kernel persistent state (state.toml). Created on boot when missing. |
| `node.brokerlink_bind` | string | `127.0.0.1:18883` | string | BrokerLink IPC listen address for edge clients (TCP loopback). |

## listeners

| Setting | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `listeners.tcp.enabled` | boolean | `true` | boolean | Whether the plaintext MQTT listener accepts connections. |
| `listeners.tcp.bind` | string | `0.0.0.0:1883` | string | Bind address for the plaintext MQTT listener. |
| `listeners.tcp.max_connections` | integer | `1000000` | 1..=10000000 | Maximum concurrent connections on the plaintext MQTT listener. |
| `listeners.tcp.backlog` | integer | `1024` | 1..=65536 | Listener accept backlog for the plaintext MQTT listener. |
| `listeners.tls.enabled` | boolean | `false` | boolean | Whether the secure TLS MQTT listener accepts connections. |
| `listeners.tls.bind` | string | `0.0.0.0:8883` | string | Bind address for the secure TLS MQTT listener. |
| `listeners.tls.cert_file` | string | `` | string | Path to the PEM server certificate for the TLS listener. |
| `listeners.tls.key_file` | string | `` | string | Path to the PEM private key for the TLS listener. |
| `listeners.ws.enabled` | boolean | `true` | boolean | Whether the MQTT-over-WebSocket listener accepts connections. |
| `listeners.ws.bind` | string | `0.0.0.0:8083` | string | Bind address for the MQTT-over-WebSocket listener. |
| `listeners.ws.path` | string | `/mqtt` | string | HTTP path serving MQTT-over-WebSocket traffic. |
| `listeners.wss.enabled` | boolean | `false` | boolean | Whether the secure WebSocket listener accepts connections. |
| `listeners.wss.bind` | string | `0.0.0.0:8084` | string | Bind address for the secure WebSocket listener. |
| `listeners.wss.path` | string | `/mqtt` | string | HTTP path serving secure WebSocket traffic. |
| `listeners.wss.cert_file` | string | `` | string | Path to the PEM server certificate for the secure WebSocket listener. |
| `listeners.wss.key_file` | string | `` | string | Path to the PEM private key for the secure WebSocket listener. |
| `listeners.api.enabled` | boolean | `true` | boolean | Whether the management REST API and dashboard serve requests. |
| `listeners.api.bind` | string | `0.0.0.0:18083` | string | Bind address for the management REST API. Empty disables the API. |

## quotas

| Setting | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `quotas.default_max_connections` | integer | `10000` | 0..=1000000 | Default max connections per authenticated username (0 = unlimited). |
| `quotas.default_max_publish_rate` | integer | `50000` | 0..=10000000 | Default token-bucket publish rate limit in messages per second (0 = unlimited). |
| `quotas.burst_multiplier` | number | `2.0` | 1.0..=10.0 | Token bucket burst multiplier (allows bursts up to burst times rate). |

## session

| Setting | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `session.max_session_expiry_secs` | integer | `86400` | 0..=2592000 | Max session expiry interval in seconds. |
| `session.max_offline_queue` | integer | `50000` | 1..=1000000 | Maximum queued offline messages per session. |
| `session.max_inflight_messages` | integer | `65535` | 1..=65535 | Maximum inflight unacknowledged QoS 1 and QoS 2 messages. |
| `session.max_qos0_backlog` | integer | `1000` | 1..=100000 | Per-subscriber QoS 0 egress backlog bound; past it the oldest queued QoS 0 frame drops. |
| `session.keep_alive_grace` | number | `1.5` | 1.0..=5.0 | Keep-alive grace multiplier before disconnect. |

## logging

| Setting | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `logging.level` | string | `info` | ["trace", "debug", "info", "warn", "error"] | Logging verbosity for the kernel (trace, debug, info, warn, error). |

## rules_engine

| Setting | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `rules_engine.window_channel_depth` | integer | `65536` | 1..=1000000 | Ingress ring buffer channel depth for stateful window worker tasks. |
| `rules_engine.backpressure_policy` | string | `DropOldest` | ["Block", "DropNewest", "DropOldest", "SpillToDisk", "RejectPublisher"] | Default memory backpressure policy when the rule buffer is full. |

## auth

| Setting | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `auth.enabled` | boolean | `true` | boolean | Whether authentication checks apply to client connects. |
| `auth.password_hash` | string | `sha256` | ["sha256", "bcrypt"] | Password hashing algorithm for stored credentials. |
| `auth.allow_anonymous` | boolean | `false` | boolean | Whether anonymous connections are accepted while no users are configured. |
| `auth.superusers` | array | `["admin", "root"]` | array | Superuser usernames bypassing ACL rules. |

## cluster

| Setting | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cluster.enabled` | boolean | `false` | boolean | Whether multi-node distributed clustering is enabled. |
| `cluster.bind` | string | `127.0.0.1:19883` | string | Cluster SWIM UDP bind address for peer discovery and membership. |
| `cluster.gossip_bind` | string | `0.0.0.0:7946` | string | Gossip membership bind address for peer discovery. |
| `cluster.quic_bind` | string | `0.0.0.0:9092` | string | Multiplexed data plane bind address for inter-broker message routing. |
| `cluster.seed_nodes` | array | `[]` | array | Seed node addresses to join an existing cluster. |

## licence

| Setting | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `licence.license_file` | string | `/etc/indramqtt/license.key` | string | Path to the enterprise cryptographic license key file. |
| `licence.license_key` | string | `` | string | Enterprise commercial license key for multi-node clustering. |
| `licence.trusted_keys_path` | string | `` | string | Trusted licence-signing keys: a JSON file or directory of JSON files. |
| `licence.request_out` | string | `` | string | Write the installation licence request to this path and exit. |
| `licence.install_file` | string | `` | string | Install the licence token read from this path and exit. |
| `licence.expiry_warn_days` | integer | `30` | 0..=365 | Days before expiry that the approaching-expiry alarm and log warning start. |

## gateway

| Setting | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gateway.coap_bind` | string | `` | string | CoAP gateway UDP listen address. Empty disables the gateway. |

## persistence

| Setting | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `persistence.stream_dir` | string | `` | string | Durable stream journal directory. Empty disables journaling. |

## ldap

| Setting | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ldap.server_url` | string | `` | string | Directory server URL for LDAP authentication. Empty disables LDAP. |
| `ldap.base_dn` | string | `` | string | Base DN under which directory users are searched. |
| `ldap.bind_dn` | string | `` | string | Service account DN used for the initial bind plus search. |
| `ldap.bind_password` | string | `` | string | Service account password for the initial bind. |
| `ldap.user_filter` | string | `(uid={username})` | string | User search filter with a {username} placeholder, escaped per RFC 4515. |
| `ldap.group_attribute` | string | `memberOf` | string | User-entry attribute listing directory groups. |
| `ldap.required_group` | string | `` | string | Required group DN: the entry must list this DN to connect. |
| `ldap.ca_cert_path` | string | `` | string | Path to a PEM CA certificate for private directories. |
| `ldap.pool_size` | integer | `8` | 1..=32 | Bound on concurrent directory authentications. |
| `ldap.connect_timeout_ms` | integer | `5000` | 100..=60000 | Timeout covering TCP connect plus TLS handshake. |
| `ldap.read_timeout_ms` | integer | `5000` | 100..=60000 | Timeout covering each directory bind/search round-trip. |

## kerberos

| Setting | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `kerberos.keytab_path` | string | `` | string | Keytab file for Kerberos authentication. Empty disables Kerberos. |
| `kerberos.service_principal` | string | `` | string | Service principal name held in the keytab. |
| `kerberos.realm` | string | `` | string | Expected service realm. Empty disables the realm check on the service name. |
| `kerberos.allowed_realms` | array | `[]` | array | Trusted client realms. Empty allows any realm that verifies. |
| `kerberos.clock_skew_secs` | integer | `300` | 1..=3600 | Clock-skew allowance in seconds for ticket validity and authenticator timestamps. |
| `kerberos.role_map` | string | `` | string | Comma-separated principal=role mappings for verified client principals. |
| `kerberos.replay_max_entries` | integer | `1024` | 16..=8192 | Replay-cache bound for Kerberos authenticators. |
